# Pump controller version 7 - shutdown procedure

Wait 15 seconds after stopping the pump.
Open the drain valve only after pressure falls below 5 kPa.
For controller version 6, this startup procedure is unsupported.
Record the shutdown timestamp in the maintenance log.
fact: For controller version 6, this startup procedure is unsupported.
content: The shutdown procedure described in this document applies to pump controller version 7. The procedure is unsupported for controller version 6; a version 6 controller must not use this shutdown procedure.
